core_obligations: Reduce to X = Spec(A) with A Noetherian (proof lines 6272-6275).
Prove (1) by pulling a nonzerodivisor back to a Zariski neighbourhood (proof lines 6277-6290).
Prove (2) by producing a nonzerodivisor in the ideal I (proof lines 6292-6312).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma, two assertions: at every point x of a locally Noetherian X the stalk S_x is the set of nonzerodivisors of O_{X,x}, so K_{X,x} is its total quotient ring; and for an affine open U the ring K_X(U) is the total quotient ring of O_X(U) (source lines 6260-6270). The proof works with X = Spec(A) for a Noetherian ring A. Part (1) shows that a nonzerodivisor f/g in the localisation pulls back to a nonzerodivisor on a Zariski neighbourhood using Noetherianity of the annihilator ideal. Part (2) rewrites a meromorphic function as a/b at each prime, produces an element of the ideal I = {a : af in A} avoiding every associated prime, and concludes with the characterisation of nonzerodivisors through associated primes.
